outline: This course provides the principal concepts and fundamental theories of thermodynamics and will cover the basic laws of thermodynamics, the energy analysis in closed systems, the energy interactions between system and environment, and the entropy analysis.
schedule:
Week   Topic
1. Introduction to Thermodynamics
2-3. General energy analysis
4-5. Properties of a pure substance
6-7. Energy analysis of closed systems
8. Midterm Exam
9. Energy analysis of closed systems
10-12. Energy analysis of open systems
13-15. The second law of Thermodynamics & Entropy analysis
16. Final Exam

category: AI 輔助學習與工具應用(AI-assisted learning and tool application)
flexible_learning.content:
(1) Week 17: Use AI tools to review and summarize the core concepts of Thermodynamics.
(2) Week 18: Analyze an engineering problem related to thermodynamic applications.
flexible_learning.outcome: Students are required to submit a report by the end of Week 18.

assessment:
Homework & Quiz: 30%
Midterm Exam: 30%
Final Exam: 30%
Final Project: 10%
